title: About
intro: Overpass is the exchange for verified African integrations. Developers share here the code that works with African services, mobile money, SMS, USSD or any other API, and the traps the official documentation leaves out.
placeholder: To be completed by the team

routes.name: Itineraries.
routes.text: Integration sheets for one service, country and stack, with the code that works, the known traps and dated checks by other developers.

track.name: The test track.
track.text: A simulator that replays with a simulated operator the real cases of a mobile payment, to test without a merchant account.

mcp.name: The MCP server.
mcp.text: It serves the sheets to coding assistants, so that the developer's AI writes the right local integration.

team.heading: The team
team.text: Overpass is built by Ghostapi, a team of two developers in Côte d'Ivoire.

contest.heading: The contest
contest.text: Overpass answers the theme of the Systalink Challenge, "Build the African exchange platform, for devs, by devs", as part of the 2026 African Developers Cup. The project is ranked by the public, the participants and the jury.
contest.link: Official page of the African Developers Cup

code.heading: Code and licences
code.text: The code is public and relies only on open source components under permissive licences.
